suppress.notes:
azure-identity 1.18.6 is outside the affected version ranges for CVE-2023-36415 and CVE-2024-35255.
CVE-2026-33117 affects Azure Key Vault Keys local cryptographic verification. This application does not include azure-security-keyvault-keys or use the affected functionality.

CVE-2026-33117 affects Azure Key Vault Keys local cryptographic verification. azure-core-http-netty is being matched as an Azure SDK dependency but does not contain the affected Key Vault Keys functionality.
CVE-2026-33117 affects Azure Key Vault Keys local cryptographic verification. azure-core is being matched as an Azure SDK dependency but does not contain the affected Key Vault Keys functionality.
CVE-2026-33117 affects Azure Key Vault Keys local cryptographic verification. azure-json is being matched as an Azure SDK dependency but does not contain the affected Key Vault Keys functionality.
CVE-2024-35255 affects msal4j versions before 1.15.1. This project resolves msal4j 1.23.1 and is therefore not affected.

These DOMPurify versions are bundled inside Swagger UI assets.
DOMPurify 3.2.6 is bundled with WireMock, which is test-only and is not included in the production runtime.
DOMPurify 3.4.12 is bundled with the production Swagger UI. Upgrading the WebJar independently breaks springdoc 3.1.0 resource resolution, so this is accepted pending an upstream springdoc upgrade with a patched version.
